name: KlusterletConfig
description: Configuration resource for Klusterlet installation and behavior on managed clusters, including bootstrap settings, install mode, proxy, CA bundles, registries, and node placement.
usageHint: Use this to define how Klusterlet is deployed and connects to the hub. Set CA bundles, proxy, install mode, and node scheduling.

hubKubeAPIServerConfig.trustedCABundles: [{ name: string, caBundle: { name: string, namespace: string } }]

nodePlacement.tolerations: [{ key: string, effect: string, value: string, operator: string, tolerationSeconds: int }]

spec.pullSecret: { name, namespace, uid, ... } (reference to pull secret)
